# Cannot compute: the CN code is missing

The ruleset requires three inputs before calculating. Your scenario provides only two:

| Required input | Provided? |
|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | ❌ Only "steel goods" given |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | ✅ India |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 3,000 t |

The default SEE depends on both the CN code and the country. For India, the table has four different values (2.53 to 4.32 tCO2e/t), so "steel goods" doesn't determine which one applies. Under the ruleset, I can't pick or average one.

## What I need from you

Please confirm the CN code of the goods. If they span more than one code, give the tonnage for each.

## Possible results for reference (not an estimate)

Once you confirm the code, the result will be one of the following. These are not a declared value.

| CN code | Good | SEE (India) | Embedded emissions for 3,000 t |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen | 2.53 | 7,590.00 tCO2e |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron/non-alloy steel | 2.64 | 7,920.00 tCO2e |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel | 4.32 | 12,960.00 tCO2e |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods with indentations (rebar) | 4.27 | 12,810.00 tCO2e |

If your goods fall under a CN code not in this table, I can't calculate them under this ruleset.
